page_texts.1: Read `.claude/commands/pattern.md` for the full workflow. Determines the architecture domain and pattern type (e.g. api, integration, event-driven, deployment), then checks `patterns/<domain>/<type>/` for an existing pattern matching the request. If none exists, derives a kebab-case title slug from the request, finds the next available PTN- number, copies the template from `resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/pattern.md`, and creates `patterns/<domain>/<type>/PTN-<DOMAIN>-<TYPE>-<NNN>-<title-slug>-pattern.md` with status `'draft'`. If one exists, revises it in place, preserving its ID and path, and logs the change in its Change History. Reviews against `patterns/pattern-quality-checklist.md` and updates `patterns/<domain>/README.md` either way. Ends with a convergence pass per `.claude/skills/ai-convergence/SKILL.md`. Patterns must be technology-agnostic solutions to recurring problems.
